rules.currency: Amounts are in EUR at the rate of the operation date.

ngr.canon: NGR = GGR - bonuses, traffic costs not deducted
ngr.why: deducting traffic costs gives profit, not NGR

ggr.canon: GGR = bets - wins, real-money bets only
ggr.why: bonus bets are excluded from GGR

ftd count.canon: FTD count = unique new depositors of the day (ftd_count)
ftd count.why: first-deposit attempts are a different metric

approval rate.why: an average of daily rates is not the period rate; NULLIF guards division by zero

ftd sum.canon: ftd_sum is lifetime deposits of the day's FTD players
ftd sum.why: it is not the day's deposits

total cost.canon: Total cost = RS + CPA + FIX + HYBRID

romi.why: NULLIF in the denominator makes division by zero explicit
